title: Fundraising Is Changing Fast. Here’s What Small Nonprofits Need to Know Now
actionable_recommendations: Focus on building relationships rather than just acquiring donations.
Implement follow-up plans for one-time donors to encourage ongoing support.
Be intentional in communication across all channels, ensuring it feels personal and relevant.
claims_requiring_current_verification: More foundations are spending down their funds now rather than distributing over decades.
Donor participation has decreased even as total charitable giving appears strong.
major_ideas: Fundraising strategies must evolve with changing donor behaviors.
Donors are increasingly favoring collective giving and community decision-making.
Many foundations now prioritize urgent social issues and seek clear outcomes.
prerequisites: Understanding of current donor behaviors and preferences.
Clear organizational strategies for applying funds effectively.
proposed_workflow: Identify clear fundraising goals and messaging.
Choose a focused donor list and conduct a single giving day campaign.
Implement a follow-up system for acknowledging and engaging with new donors.
tools_templates_resources: AI tools for donor communications and engagement insights.
